projectName: Web Import Center and Duplicate Review
description: Add a web import center for CSV onboarding and ongoing import maintenance, including parser detection, preview, duplicate warnings, and operator-friendly results. This is intentionally scheduled after tax-first value is delivered.

timing.gatingCondition: Proceed after tax, portfolio, and ledger/write features make the web app useful even without web imports.

principles: Day-2 Feature, Not Neglected - imports matter, but they are intentionally sequenced after the tax-critical flows
Preview Before Commit - importing remains a review-first workflow
Duplicate Awareness - surface likely duplicate rows before writing
Parser Reuse - the web flow wraps the existing Python importer registry rather than reinventing source parsing
Operator Recovery - failed imports must return actionable feedback rather than partial mystery states

techStack.testing: pytest parser/API tests + upload flow smoke tests

userStories.title: Upload, detect, and parse import files
acceptanceCriteria: Allow authenticated CSV upload from web UI
Detect parser source automatically or allow explicit override
Return parsed preview rows and source metadata without committing data
Support both exchange and wallet parser flows
userStories.testStrategy: pytest upload/detection endpoint tests using fixture CSVs

userStories.title: Import configuration and wallet assignment
acceptanceCriteria: Support withdraw-to wallet and wallet-name configuration inputs where parser types require them
Reuse existing wallet selector/new-wallet semantics from the app
Validate required import parameters before execution
Keep configuration model aligned with CLI/TUI import behavior
userStories.testStrategy: pytest import configuration tests across parser classes

userStories.title: Duplicate detection preview and review workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Run duplicate detection before commit using the existing validation utilities
Show a clear warning banner and mark likely duplicate rows in the preview
Allow the operator to proceed intentionally after review
Summarize duplicate counts in the final result
userStories.testStrategy: pytest duplicate-preview API tests + frontend warning-state smoke tests

userStories.title: Execute import and return operator-friendly results
acceptanceCriteria: Execute imports through the Python import pipeline with imported/skipped/error counts
Return actionable error messages when parsing or writes fail
Refresh portfolio/ledger views after successful imports
Avoid silent partial failures
userStories.testStrategy: pytest end-to-end import route tests against fixture files and test database

userStories.title: Import history and troubleshooting aids
acceptanceCriteria: Show recent import runs with source, date, and result counts
Provide parser format help in the web UI using existing parser metadata where possible
Document best practices for exchange/wallet export files and duplicate avoidance
Keep implementation simple enough for a private single-operator workflow
userStories.testStrategy: Manual review + targeted API tests for import history metadata

high: Import bugs can silently corrupt ledger correctness if preview and validation are weak
Large files or malformed exports may create poor UX without careful error handling
medium: Browser upload constraints and parser expectations may vary more than TUI file-path flows
Duplicate review UX can become noisy if not concise
low: The parser registry and duplicate-detection logic already exist in the Python core
Scheduling imports after tax/portfolio delivery reduces overall project risk

preFlightChecklist: Confirm allowed upload size and retention behavior for temp files
Decide whether import history is persisted or just logged
Document which import sources matter most in first web release
